WHAT IS SYJ LABS?

A public catalogue of independent technology work.

AI · C++

SYJ-LLM

Offline-first LLM runtime in C/C++ for low-RAM devices (~4GB). Built on llama.cpp + GGUF with memory-safe budgeting, no cloud, no API keys. Cross-platform: Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS, Android, WASM. By SAYANJALI NEXUS.
